technical.summary: Strong trend structure with overbought conditions and no active strategy triggers limit entry quality; price extended above key moving averages but momentum indicators show fatigue.

fundamental.summary: SO shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 15 days—insufficient fundamental or smart money conviction to support a trade.

sentiment.summary: Market fear (32/100) presents contrarian opportunity, but congressional activity is stale and mixed with no recent conviction signals.

risk.summary: Crisis VIX (393.44), flat yield curve, recent CPI event, and earnings in 15 days create a highly adverse macro backdrop for SO.

debate.key_bull_argument: Strong ADX trend, bullish EMA 50/200 crossover, and price above Ichimoku cloud provide structural upside confirmation in a fear-driven market contrarian setup.
debate.key_bear_argument: Crisis VIX, dual RSI overbought conditions, earnings risk in 15 days, zero fundamental conviction, no active strategy triggers, and price below both 50-SMA and 200-EMA create a high-risk entry into macro headwinds.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical trend structure is sound (ADX strong, EMA bullish), but overbought RSI conditions combined with zero fundamental conviction and crisis macro backdrop create unfavorable risk/reward. Earnings in 15 days add execution risk that outweighs contrarian sentiment opportunity.
decision.primary_risk: Crisis VIX (393.44) and earnings event within 15 days create binary downside risk; dual RSI overbought suggests momentum exhaustion into macro headwinds.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — technical, fundamental, risk, and debate agents all converge on bear case; only sentiment offers weak contrarian counterpoint
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding SO with 65 existing Utilities positions (16% of portfolio); sector concentration and existing ticker exposure reduce conviction further and argue against new entry.
